_README: CAPTURED, NOT WRITTEN. Regenerate with: cd backend && npm run capture:coldopen

original.request: Run a full marathon in 3 weeks, never having run before.

counter.statement: Set a first running milestone that's actually buildable in your window: complete a 5K on race day in ~8 weeks, training 4 days a week from a true zero baseline. (If you want the marathon itself, treat it as a 6–9 month build — not a 3-week ask.)
counter.subtitle: Right ambition, impossible timeline — let's build the version you can actually finish.

risk.line: Zero running base + a 21-day marathon = a body that will not survive the attempt.
risk.detail: Going from never-running to 26.2 miles in three weeks isn't slow or hard — it's structurally impossible, and pushing it risks real injury. That's already priced into the 3% odds, which is why this can't be greenlit as stated.
